General Information
NEW in the Original Packaging
Stocked & Shipped From – LEXINGTON, KY
What is This Part?
This is the Front Bumper and Both Front Bumper End Caps.
This is an OEM Front Bumper that was made by Suzuki that is pre-painted black and comes with the Bumper Corner Caps for both sides and the install clips.
Direct Replacement
What Will I Receive?
Qty 1 – Front Bumper
Qty 1 – LH Protector Cap (Drivers Side)
Qty 1 – RH Protector Cap (Passengers Side)
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Samurai 1985 – 1995 All Models
Suzuki SJ413 1985 – 1995 All Models
Suzuki SJ410 1980 – 1984 All Models
